preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: Each word in the dictionary is a string.

postconditions.description: The return value is a list.

postconditions.expression: all(word in dictionary for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each word in the return value is in the dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(word) == sorted(jumble) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each word in the return value is an anagram of the jumble.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [word for word in dictionary if sorted(word) == sorted(jumble)]
postconditions.description: The return value contains all words from the dictionary that are anagrams of the jumble, in the same order.
